notes.title: Update notes March 20
notes.content: Added favorite and feedback button to the end of the story panel. Fixed placement of End button. Added minimum length of feedback field to 10 characters.

notes.title: Dimensions: Story Mode Now Available!
notes.content:
We are very proud to announce that Dimensions: Story Mode is now available for immediate download. Story Mode is the third app in the Dimensions franchise, to complement the brothel management game Dimensions VIP, and with the first Dimensions Bite Size as an additional nugget to whet your appetite.

Story Mode is the stories from the Dimensions universe but without the gameplay. If you play Dimensions VIP mostly for the stories, then Story Mode is your perfect companion. No waiting, no struggle to find unlockable stories, just download and watch. 

As with the rest of the Dimensions games, we're continuously expanding the universe, and all past, current, and future content will be included in Story Mode automatically on release. In other words, you're not just getting the 40+ hand-drawn stories that are already out, you also get any future stories included in the same price.

In fact, we are releasing several new stories right now to expand on the existing dimensions and explore the character stories of new girls. The artists are already working on new content as well, and as soon as that is ready for release, you'll get it immediately.

Dimensions: Story Mode is available exclusively on Steam now with a 15% launch discount.
